findings.detail: mTLS with Ed25519/ECDSA certificates rejects all non-whitelisted certificates fail-closed.
Monotonic coordinator incarnations reject stale permits and prevent concurrent conflicting writes.
Permit timestamps and nonces with 15-second lease window prevent packet replay.
Mutual exclusion lock between garbage collection sweeps and active repair processes prevents premature shard deletion.
SIGKILL crash during commit preserves WAL consistency with CRC32 verification and atomic manifest compactions.
